extracted.name: Lentil & tuna salad
extracted.description: Throw together this easy, no-cook lentil and tuna salad for a speedy and healthy lunch or supper. It takes just 15 minutes to make – ideal for busy days
ingredient_lines: 2 x 160g cans tuna steaks in spring water, drained and flaked
½ small bunch of chives finely chopped, plus extra to garnish
instruction_lines: Whisk the vinegar, mustard and garlic together in a small bowl. Slowly drizzle in the oil, whisking as you go, until emulsified, then season to taste.
Add the lentils, tuna, tomatoes, peppers and herbs to a large bowl and toss together. Pour over the dressing and toss again. Divide between four bowls and garnish with the remaining chives.
